Metadata.Time Period: 2014 to present, minus the most recent three days

columns.name: CB_NO
columns.description: Central Booking Number – uniquely identifies the arrest report

columns.name: CASE NUMBER
columns.description: Records Division Number – uniquely identifies the criminal incident report associated with the arrest . This column, if populated, corresponds to Case Number in https://data.cityofchicago.org/Public-Safety/Crimes-2001-to-present/ijzp-q8t2 and can be used to link the datasets.

columns.name: ARREST DATE
columns.description: Date and time of arrest.

columns.name: RACE
columns.description: The race/ethnicity of the person arrested.

columns.name: CHARGE 1 STATUTE
columns.description: Statute for most serious charge (based on class and type, then arrest report order in case of tie).

columns.name: CHARGE 1 DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Statute description for most serious charge (based on class and type, then arrest report order in case of tie).

columns.name: CHARGE 1 TYPE
columns.description: Charge type for most serious charge (F = felony; M = misdemeanor; Null = local ordinance, traffic arrest, other)

columns.name: CHARGE 1 CLASS
columns.description: Charge class for most serious charge (If F then X, 1, 2, 3, or 4; If M then A, B, or C; L = local ordinance violation; P = petty offense; U = business offense; Z = used for warrant arrests, criminal registration violations, and violations of court orders)

columns.name: CHARGES STATUTE
columns.description: The statutes of the first four charges filed, separated by the | character with a space on each side. Values are always listed in the same order. In other words, the nth value in each list will refer to the same charge. The "Contains" operator can be used in a filter to search for presence of a value in any of the charges.
